name: Liang Hong 梁鴻
bio: Liang Hong (梁鴻, courtesy name Boluan) was an Eastern Han scholar and recluse who refused office and lived in poverty. He is remembered with his wife Meng Guang, who, in the well-known story, raised his food tray to the level of her brow in respect.

His Wu yi ge, the Song of the Five Sighs, laments the palace-building of the Han court, which weighed on the common people. According to the Hou Han shu, the song displeased Emperor Zhang, and Liang Hong had to flee and change his name.

poems.title: 五噫歌 (Wu yi ge)
poems.author: Liang Hong 梁鴻
poems.text:
陟彼北芒兮，噫！
顧瞻帝京兮，噫！
宮闕崔巍兮，噫！
民之劬勞兮，噫！
遼遼未央兮，噫！
